current.exact_claim: For a proper nested confocal ellipse pair admitting an odd primitive Poncelet billiard family, the product of the signed areas obtained by unit-circle inversion of the original orbit vertices in the two original foci is constant along each admitted family, including all coprime stars and reversal. For every integer r>=1, repeating an odd primitive cycle r times scales each signed area by r and the product by r squared.
